texts.zh:
游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
texts.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculiar things for our arkships to behold, each new vista is an opportunity to learn something new, reflect and grow.

# 值得观赏的景色 / A Sight to Behold

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:14821-14850; common/ascension_perks/00_ascension_perks.txt:671 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

取得飞升天赋“浪迹星涯”（ap_wanderlust）时 on_enabled 触发 nomads.4715。

Taking the ascension perk Wanderlust (ap_wanderlust) fires nomads.4715 from its on_enabled.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

窗口之后开启事件链“游牧浪子”，此后方舟舰造访新星系会推进该链（nomads.4720）。

Afterwards the chain Nomadic Wanderlust begins; arkship visits to new systems advance it (nomads.4720).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个回答按是否排外区分，效果相同。

Two replies by xenophobia, same effect.
